+    private func recordRoomInputFailure(_ stage: String, field: XCUIElement, in app: XCUIApplication) {
+        let description = "Stage: \(stage)\nField: \(field.debugDescription)\n" + app.debugDescription
+        let bounded = String(decoding: description.utf8.prefix(32_768), as: UTF8.self)
+        print("Room-measurement-input-failure (at most 32,768 UTF-8 bytes):\n\(bounded)")
+        let hierarchy = XCTAttachment(string: bounded)
+        hierarchy.name = "Room-measurement-input-hierarchy"
+        hierarchy.lifetime = .keepAlways

commit_delta.description: The candidate commit changes only UITests/StudioContentReachability.swift, adding room input readiness and failure evidence. Earlier reachability changes already present in this candidate are outside this commit delta.

findings.detail: Existing Clear is tapped once, field.typeText(text) remains exactly one occurrence without a retry loop, and Set is tapped once after both exact-draft assertions. Extra taps request focus, not replacement values; no programmatic app text injection.

Waits at most the configured 10 seconds for exists && value == requested text, asserts wait completion, then retains the original direct XCTAssertEqual(field.value as? String, text). No tolerance, normalization, placeholder acceptance, or retry typing added.

ManualRoomPlacementUITests.swift has unchanged blob c6f6f4f8ea1d9c7289cead11b47327f1ee1878aa. ManualRoomPlacementView.swift is unchanged blob37ab4a07b45600b2e1c6e4aa76eb8bddd36196a6; StudioTextField.swift is unchanged blob0d5481be3b13fd06acb9fe2674af503b8a7ec6a9. Rejected resize, signed precision, explicit restore, notes, undo/save/relaunch behavior is neither altered nor bypassed.

After Clear and initial tap, calls the existing exact-copy keyboard introduction handler, requests full field visibility using actual keyboard-aware container bounds, taps again, then waits for numeric key1 to exist and be hittable. This is an explicit precondition check, not merely a longer delay.

New keyboard and exact-draft waits are each configured10 seconds. The reused reveal helper permits at most12 iterations; no new unbounded retry or sleep. Existing field existence5 seconds and post-Set keyboard-disappearance10 seconds remain. Accessibility IPC and screenshot acquisition are not strictly wall-clock bounded by those expectation deadlines.

On keyboard readiness or exact-draft timeout, captures stage, actual field debugDescription and app hierarchy, prints and retains a bounded text attachment, then captures actual app screenshot with keepAlways. No synthetic image or fixture state. Existing reveal failures use their own geometry/screenshot/hierarchy diagnostics.

Full field/app debugDescription strings are acquired before truncation, so only retained text is capped, not AX traversal cost. String(decoding: utf8.prefix(32768), as: UTF8.self) can replace a truncated multibyte character with U+FFFD, making re-encoded UTF-8 up to32770 bytes; this small bound-label imprecision is nonblocking for the room-input candidate.

The original room failure artifact remains unviewed. Numeric keyboard readiness and exact draft visibility are plausible missing synchronization preconditions; no new run was inspected. Success of this patch would still require actual required method outcomes and preserved downstream assertions, not relabeling the old failure.
